title: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager: security flaw used in attacks
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed. The vulnerability is 38 days old, so many systems are likely still unpatched. It affects a product that faces the internet or gives remote access. The severity score is critical (9.8).

category.label: VPN, firewall or gateway
category.why: It sits at the edge of your network and faces the internet, so attackers can reach it directly.
category.doThis: If you have it, patch it today. If you cannot, block access to it from the internet until you can.

summary: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager contains a hex encoding vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to access an affected system with privileges of the admin user due to improper handling of URI encoding in an HTTP request.
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. The deadline CISA set for US federal agencies, Oct 3, 2026, has passed. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.
